consensus._note: Standalone street EPS standing on 30-Sep-2026: PL 56.6 / 65.2; Emkay (May) 57.2 / 64.4, cut ~5% in Aug; Geojit implied FY28E ~69 (Rs2,070 / 30x). Average of the three disclosed FY28E: ~66.

street.methodSummary: P/E is the main method: Motilal Oswal 38x 12-month-forward EPS (standalone), Geojit 30x FY28E, Prabhudas Lilladher 25x FY28E combined-entity EPS, Nuvama on P/E. ICICI Securities and Emkay use a sum of the parts (ICICI: EV/EBITDA, Sun 22x and Organon 6x). The Organon deal has split the street on WHICH earnings to capitalise, not on the method.

ownership.pledge: No promoter shares pledged or encumbered
ownership.trend: FPIs fell from 18.0% (Dec-2024) to 14.5% (Jun-2026); domestic institutions rose from 18.4% to 22.1%; promoters unchanged at 54.48% for two years

governance.board: Nine directors: four executives (Dilip Shanghvi, Kirti Ganorkar, Aalok Shanghvi, Vidhi Shanghvi; three of them from the founding family) and five independents (Pawan Goenka, Gautam Doshi, Rolf Hoffmann, Satyavati Berera, Andreas Busch).
governance.succession: Founder Dilip Shanghvi (b. 1955) moved from MD to executive chairman on 1-Sep-2025; professional MD Kirti Ganorkar; son Aalok Shanghvi is COO and the best-paid executive (Rs9.3 cr in FY26); daughter Vidhi Shanghvi joined the board in May-2025.
governance.pay: FY26: Dilip Shanghvi Rs7.06 cr (111x median, +22%), Aalok Shanghvi Rs9.32 cr (128x, +20%), Kirti Ganorkar Rs5.87 cr (part year), Vidhi Shanghvi Rs2.0 cr; median employee pay +0.66%. Modest by global standards, but the family's pay rose ~20% in a year when the median employee got <1%.
governance.related: Aditya Medisales Ltd, a promoter-group company, holds 1.67%; promoter holdings are concentrated in Shanghvi Finance Pvt Ltd (40.3%). No pledges.
governance.regulatory: Four plants under US FDA action (Halol import alert since Dec-2022; Mohali consent-decree batch certification; Dadra and Baska OAI/warning letter); recurring US litigation charges (Ranbaxy-era claims, Taro price-fixing, opioids) every year FY22-FY26.
governance.capitalAllocation: History of value-creating deals funded by cash (Taro, DUSA, Concert, Checkpoint) and one large all-stock deal (Ranbaxy, ~15% dilution, the chairman's own regret). Organon is the largest ever and the first to use heavy debt.
